SELECT d.calendar_date, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, d.fiscal_week, d.is_trading_day, d.holiday_name,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE s.store_id=131 AND p.sku=101624 AND f.sale_date=d.calendar_date) AS lines,
  (SELECT sum(f.quantity) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE s.store_id=131 AND p.sku=101624 AND f.sale_date=d.calendar_date) AS units,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS dup_keys_all,
  (SELECT max(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line) AS max_sale_date,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM ref_store_closure WHERE store_id=131 AND closure_end_date >= DATE '2026-09-28' AND closure_start_date <= DATE '2026-10-04') AS closures
FROM dim_date d WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-21' AND DATE '2026-10-11' ORDER BY 1

SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.sale_ts_utc, f.store_key, f.product_key, f.channel_code, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.staff_purchase_flag, f.etl_loaded_at,
  count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no) AS n_same_key
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE s.store_id=131 AND p.sku=101624 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04'
ORDER BY f.sale_date, f.receipt_id

SELECT sale_date, count(*) AS dup_keys, min(etl_loaded_at) AS min_load, max(etl_loaded_at) AS max_load FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no, min(sale_date) AS sale_date, min(etl_loaded_at) AS etl_loaded_at FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT
 (SELECT sum(f.quantity) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE s.store_id=131 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04') AS store_units_fact,
 (SELECT sum(units_sold) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=131 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04') AS store_units_rpt,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE s.store_id=131 AND p.sku=101624 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04' AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', f.sale_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) <> f.sale_date) AS date_mismatch,
 (SELECT coalesce(sum(r.quantity_returned),0) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key WHERE s.store_id=131 AND p.sku=101624 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04') AS returned_units_in_week,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE s.store_id=131 AND p.sku=101624 AND f.staff_purchase_flag AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04') AS staff_lines
